<section id="A2" class="ltx_appendix">
<h2 class="ltx_title ltx_title_appendix"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_appendix">Appendix B </span>Metrics and Evidence Protocol</h2>

<div id="A2.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The five component metrics lie in <math id="A2.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="[0,100]" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mn>0,100</mn><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">[0,100]</annotation></semantics></math> and are reported individually,
alongside the descriptive Overall Score defined below. Component claims, shot
IDs, matching rules, thresholds, and denominators are frozen before test
outputs are inspected.</p>
</div>
<div id="A2.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A2.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Script Content Fidelity (SCF).</span>
Let <math id="A2.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="c_{1},\ldots,c_{m}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>c</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">…</mi><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>c</mi><mi>m</mi></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">c_{1},\ldots,c_{m}</annotation></semantics></math> be the claims in source script <math id="A2.p2.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="S" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>S</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">S</annotation></semantics></math>, and
<math id="A2.p2.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="s_{1},\ldots,s_{k}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>s</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">…</mi><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>s</mi><mi>k</mi></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">s_{1},\ldots,s_{k}</annotation></semantics></math> the claims in output narration <math id="A2.p2.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{V}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒱</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathcal{V}</annotation></semantics></math>.
The entailment indicator <math id="A2.p2.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="E(a,B)\in\{0,1\}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>E</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>a</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>B</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">{</mo><mrow><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo stretchy="false">}</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">E(a,B)\in\{0,1\}</annotation></semantics></math> tests whether text <math id="A2.p2.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="B" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>B</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">B</annotation></semantics></math> supports claim <math id="A2.p2.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="a" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>a</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">a</annotation></semantics></math>,
and <math id="A2.p2.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\tau_{K}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>τ</mi><mi>K</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\tau_{K}</annotation></semantics></math> is the Kendall order correlation of matched source and output claims.
We compute</p>
<table id="A2.EGx4" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_align ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody id="A2.Ex5"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A2.Ex5.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\mathrm{Cov}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>Cov</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\mathrm{Cov}</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A2.Ex5.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle=m^{-1}\sum_{i=1}^{m}E(c_{i},\mathcal{V})," display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>=</mo><mrow><msup><mi>m</mi><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><munderover><mo movablelimits="false">∑</mo><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mi>m</mi></munderover></mstyle><mrow><mi>E</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>c</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒱</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>,</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle=m^{-1}\sum_{i=1}^{m}E(c_{i},\mathcal{V}),</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A2.Ex5.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\mathrm{Faith}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>Faith</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\mathrm{Faith}</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A2.Ex5.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle=k^{-1}\sum_{j=1}^{k}E(s_{j},S)," display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>=</mo><mrow><msup><mi>k</mi><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><munderover><mo movablelimits="false">∑</mo><mrow><mi>j</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mi>k</mi></munderover></mstyle><mrow><mi>E</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>s</mi><mi>j</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><mi>S</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>,</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle=k^{-1}\sum_{j=1}^{k}E(s_{j},S),</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
<tbody id="A2.E14"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>

<p id="A2.p2.2" class="ltx_p">SCF is valid for at least five source claims and one narration unit.</p>
</div>
<div id="A2.p3" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A2.p3.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.p3.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Visual–Narration Semantic Match (VNSM).</span>
Let <math id="A2.p3.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{S}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒮</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathcal{S}</annotation></semantics></math> contain the registered shots with a valid evaluator response.
For each shot <math id="A2.p3.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="s" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>s</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">s</annotation></semantics></math>, four uniformly sampled frames form montage <math id="A2.p3.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="F_{s}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>F</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">F_{s}</annotation></semantics></math>, paired
with concurrent narration <math id="A2.p3.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="T_{s}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>T</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">T_{s}</annotation></semantics></math>. The held-out Claude Opus 5 evaluator assigns
an anchored grade <math id="A2.p3.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="g_{s}=g(F_{s},T_{s})\in\{1,2,3,4\}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>g</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>g</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>F</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>T</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">{</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn></mrow><mo stretchy="false">}</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">g_{s}=g(F_{s},T_{s})\in\{1,2,3,4\}</annotation></semantics></math> (Poor, Fair, Good,
Excellent) using the rubric below. We rescale grades to <math id="A2.p3.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="[0,100]" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mn>0,100</mn><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">[0,100]</annotation></semantics></math> and aggregate</p>

</table>
<p id="A2.p5.3" class="ltx_p">LHC requires <math id="A2.p5.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="N\geq 12" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>N</mi><mo>≥</mo><mn>12</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">N\geq 12</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="A2.p5.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\bar{q}_{H}\geq 0.5" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>q</mi><mo>¯</mo></mover><mi>H</mi></msub><mo>≥</mo><mn>0.5</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\bar{q}_{H}\geq 0.5</annotation></semantics></math>.</p>
</div>
<div id="A2.p6" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A2.p6.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.p6.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">End-to-End Rendering Yield (ERY).</span></p>
<table id="A2.E19" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.E19.m1" class="ltx_math_unparsed" alttext="\mathrm{ERY}=\frac{100}{N_{\rm total}}\sum_{c}\mathbf{1}[\mathrm{ok}(c)],\quad\mathrm{ok}=\mathrm{exists}\wedge\mathrm{decodable}\wedge[D^{\rm act}\geq 0.5D^{\rm plan}]\wedge\mathrm{hasNarration}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>ERY</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>100</mn><msub><mi>N</mi><mi>total</mi></msub></mfrac><munder><mo movablelimits="false">∑</mo><mi>c</mi></munder><mn>𝟏</mn><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mi>ok</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>c</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow><mo rspace="1.167em">,</mo><mi>ok</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>exists</mi><mo>∧</mo><mi>decodable</mi><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><msup><mi>D</mi><mi>act</mi></msup><mo>≥</mo><mn>0.5</mn><msup><mi>D</mi><mi>plan</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mi>hasNarration</mi><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathrm{ERY}=\frac{100}{N_{\rm total}}\sum_{c}\mathbf{1}[\mathrm{ok}(c)],\quad\mathrm{ok}=\mathrm{exists}\wedge\mathrm{decodable}\wedge[D^{\rm act}\geq 0.5D^{\rm plan}]\wedge\mathrm{hasNarration}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(19)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.p6.2" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.p6.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps">hasNarration</span> requires non-silent speech covering at least half of the
planned narration duration. Background music does not qualify. Timeouts,
crashes, and unstarted tasks remain in the denominator.</p>
</div>
<div id="A2.p7" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A2.p7.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.p7.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Overall Score (descriptive summary).</span>
For each model or system within a comparison track, let <math id="A2.p7.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\overline{M}_{k}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>M</mi><mo stretchy="true">¯</mo></mover><mi>k</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\overline{M}_{k}</annotation></semantics></math>
denote its reported mean for component <math id="A2.p7.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="k" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>k</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">k</annotation></semantics></math>. We add a post-hoc descriptive
summary of these means:</p>
<table id="A2.E20" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.E20.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathrm{Overall}=\frac{1}{5}\sum_{k\in\{\mathrm{SCF,VNSM,TPR,LHC,ERY}\}}\overline{M}_{k}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>Overall</mi><mo>=</mo><mrow><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>5</mn></mfrac><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><munder><mo movablelimits="false">∑</mo><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">{</mo><mrow><mi>SCF</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>VNSM</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>TPR</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>LHC</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>ERY</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">}</mo></mrow></mrow></munder><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>M</mi><mo stretchy="true">¯</mo></mover><mi>k</mi></msub></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathrm{Overall}=\frac{1}{5}\sum_{k\in\{\mathrm{SCF,VNSM,TPR,LHC,ERY}\}}\overline{M}_{k}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(20)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.p7.2" class="ltx_p">Each component receives weight <math id="A2.p7.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="0.2" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>0.2</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0.2</annotation></semantics></math>. These weights are not fitted to model
rankings or human preferences. The shared <math id="A2.p7.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="[0,100]" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mn>0,100</mn><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">[0,100]</annotation></semantics></math> scale makes this a transparent
macro-average, but does not make the components independent or equally
calibrated: LHC already incorporates VNSM in shot health. Overall therefore
summarizes task performance rather than serving as a separately validated
measure of perceptual video quality. It is distinct from the human-rated
overall preference in Table <a href="#S6.T4" title="Table 4 ‣ 6.5 Human Evaluation ‣ 6 Experiments ‣ WeVisCut: The Whole Editing Room in One AgentFrom Narration to Long-Form Video" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">4</span></a>.</p>
</div>
<div id="A2.p8" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A2.p8.1" class="ltx_p">The displayed scores are computed from the reported, rounded component means
and rounded to one decimal place. Each component retains its own eligibility
rules and denominator. Overall does not imply a common per-task population.
If any component mean is unavailable, Overall is N/A rather than an average
over the remaining metrics. Costs are excluded. We report no Overall standard
deviation, confidence interval, or significance test: these require aligned
run-level results or the cross-metric covariance, which cannot be recovered
from the component standard deviations alone. All five components remain
visible so that the summary does not conceal trade-offs.</p>
</div>
<div id="A2.p9" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A2.p9.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.p9.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Production Cost Efficiency (PCE).</span>
For tool calls or generated tokens <math id="A2.p9.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="X" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>X</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">X</annotation></semantics></math>,</p>
<table id="A2.E21" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.E21.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathrm{PCE}_{X}=\frac{\sum_{c\in\mathcal{C}_{\rm all}}X(c)}{\sum_{c\in\mathcal{C}_{\rm ok}}D_{c}^{\rm act}/60}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>PCE</mi><mi>X</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><msub><mo>∑</mo><mrow><mi>c</mi><mo>∈</mo><msub><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒞</mi><mi>all</mi></msub></mrow></msub><mrow><mi>X</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>c</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mrow><mrow><msub><mo>∑</mo><mrow><mi>c</mi><mo>∈</mo><msub><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒞</mi><mi>ok</mi></msub></mrow></msub><msubsup><mi>D</mi><mi>c</mi><mi>act</mi></msubsup></mrow><mo>/</mo><mn>60</mn></mrow></mfrac></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathrm{PCE}_{X}=\frac{\sum_{c\in\mathcal{C}_{\rm all}}X(c)}{\sum_{c\in\mathcal{C}_{\rm ok}}D_{c}^{\rm act}/60}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(21)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.p9.2" class="ltx_p">PCE is lower-is-better and is never combined with quality. Eligibility counts
and validity conditions are recorded alongside metric reporting. Conditional
means use valid tasks, whereas unconditional means assign zero to system
failures. Harness or provider outages remain missing rather than being
converted into low-quality scores.</p>
</div>
<section id="A2.SS1" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">B.1 </span>Diagnostic Validation</h3>

<div id="A2.SS1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A2.SS1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">We apply three strengths of metric-targeted corruption: claim edits (SCF),
time-local visual substitution (VNSM), shot removal/duration/order changes
(TPR), tail degradation or asset repetition (LHC), and delivery failure (ERY).
For each metric–corruption pair we report the paired drop, bootstrap 95%
interval, severity monotonicity, and the <math id="A2.SS1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="5\times 5" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>5</mn><mo lspace="0.222em" rspace="0.222em">×</mo><mn>5</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">5\times 5</annotation></semantics></math> sensitivity matrix. Human
pairwise validation is metric-specific and blinded. VNSM additionally reports
cross-family judge agreement and human correlation. Agreement below
Krippendorff’s <math id="A2.SS1.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\alpha=0.6" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>α</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0.6</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\alpha=0.6</annotation></semantics></math> prevents a standalone VNSM claim.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A2.SS2" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">B.2 </span>Evidence-Seeking Harness</h3>

<div id="A2.SS2.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A2.SS2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">At most three <math id="A2.SS2.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="4\times 4" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>4</mn><mo lspace="0.222em" rspace="0.222em">×</mo><mn>4</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">4\times 4</annotation></semantics></math> contact sheets are generated per video with sampling
step</p>
<table id="A2.E22" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A2.E22.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\Delta=\max\!\left(1,\Delta_{\rm user},\left\lceil N/(16S_{\max})\right\rceil\right),\qquad S_{\max}=3." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mo>=</mo><mrow><mpadded style="width:1.808em;" width="1.808em"><mi>max</mi></mpadded><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mi>user</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><mrow><mo>⌈</mo><mrow><mi>N</mi><mo>/</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mn>16</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>S</mi><mi>max</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>⌉</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo rspace="2.167em">,</mo><mrow><msub><mi>S</mi><mi>max</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\Delta=\max\!\left(1,\Delta_{\rm user},\left\lceil N/(16S_{\max})\right\rceil\right),\qquad S_{\max}=3.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(22)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A2.SS2.p1.2" class="ltx_p">Tiles carry source-frame and timestamp labels, while a sidecar stores FPS,
duration, sampling step, and sheet count. Representative inputs are shown in
Appendix <a href="#A5" title="Appendix E Visual Inputs to the Evaluation Harness ‣ WeVisCut: The Whole Editing Room in One AgentFrom Narration to Long-Form Video" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">E</span></a>. Read-only mounts isolate the evidence available
to each metric. SCF sees script and narration, while VNSM sees aligned narration
and rendered frames/clips. TPR sees plan and realized timeline. LHC sees ordered
health inputs and asset digests. ERY/PCE see delivery probes and accounting.
The network-free harness may call only bounded FFmpeg (editing and probing),
PySceneDetect (scene detection), Whisper (ASR), PaddleOCR (OCR), frozen
detectors, and manifest/diff readers. Tools expose evidence but never scores,
and every call is archived.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A2.SS3" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">B.3 </span>Held-Out VNSM Evaluator Prompt</h3>

<div id="A2.SS3.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A2.SS3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The evaluator is called independently for each registered shot. The
complete version tuple—prompt, rubric, model snapshot, decoding parameters,
sampler, and JSON schema—is frozen after development-only calibration and
before any test output is rendered. Figure <a href="#A2.F6" title="Figure 6 ‣ B.3 Held-Out VNSM Evaluator Prompt ‣ Appendix B Metrics and Evidence Protocol ‣ WeVisCut: The Whole Editing Room in One AgentFrom Narration to Long-Form Video" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">6</span></a> visualizes
the exact evidence path. The four image tiles are frames sampled by the
evaluation harness rather than illustrative replacements.</p>
</div>
<figure id="A2.F6" class="ltx_figure"><img src="2610.38352v1/Figure6.png" id="A2.F6.g1" class="ltx_graphics ltx_centering ltx_img_landscape" style="aspect-ratio:476/189;" width="476" height="189" alt="Refer to caption">
<figcaption class="ltx_caption ltx_centering"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_figure">Figure 6: </span>Auditable VNSM evaluator path. A shot packet binds the narration
window, timestamps, video and manifest digests, sampler/prompt versions,
judge snapshot, and decoding configuration. The frozen sampler exposes
four timestamped frames and, only when motion is necessary, one bounded
clip. The held-out Claude Opus 5 evaluator must first record visible
evidence, then choose one anchored grade and emit schema-validated JSON.
Aggregation excludes
unavailable calls rather than converting infrastructure failure into a
zero-quality judgment.</figcaption>
</figure>
<div id="A2.SS3.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent"><span class="ltx_inline-block"><svg id="A2.SS3.p2.pic1" class="ltx_picture" height="775.94" overflow="visible" version="1.1" viewBox="0 0 653.15 775.94" width="653.15"><g style="--ltx-stroke-color:#000000;--ltx-fill-color:#000000;" fill="#000000" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0.4pt" transform="translate(0,775.94) matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 0)"><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#2A5C91;" fill="#2A5C91" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 0 7.01 L 0 768.93 C 0 772.8 3.14 775.94 7.01 775.94 L 646.14 775.94 C 650.01 775.94 653.15 772.8 653.15 768.93 L 653.15 7.01 C 653.15 3.14 650.01 0 646.14 0 L 7.01 0 C 3.14 0 0 3.14 0 7.01 Z"></path></g><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#F7F9FC;" fill="#F7F9FC" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 1.11 7.01 L 1.11 753.55 L 652.04 753.55 L 652.04 7.01 C 652.04 3.75 649.4 1.11 646.14 1.11 L 7.01 1.11 C 3.75 1.11 1.11 3.75 1.11 7.01 Z"></path></g><g fill-opacity="1.0" transform="matrix(1.0 0.0 0.0 1.0 14.89 761.29)"><foreignObject style="--ltx-fo-width:39.17em;--ltx-fo-height:0.69em;--ltx-fo-depth:0.19em;font-size:10pt;" height="12.3" overflow="visible" transform="matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 9.61)" width="542"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_container"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_content">
<span id="A2.SS3.p2.pic1.1" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:39.17em;">
<span id="A2.SS3.p2.pic1.1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.SS3.p2.pic1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#FFFFFF;">Held-Out VNSM Evaluator: System Contract</span></span>
</span></span></span></foreignObject></g><g fill-opacity="1.0" transform="matrix(1.0 0.0 0.0 1.0 14.89 15.61)"><foreignObject style="--ltx-fo-width:45.05em;--ltx-fo-height:52.48em;--ltx-fo-depth:0.19em;font-size:10pt;" height="728.83" overflow="visible" transform="matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 726.14)" width="623.37"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_container"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_content">
<span id="A2.SS3.p2.pic1.2" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:45.05em;">
<span id="A2.SS3.p2.pic1.2.1" class="ltx_p ltx_align_left"><span id="A2.SS3.p2.pic1.2.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Role.<span id="A2.SS3.p2.pic1.2.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_medium"> You are an evidence-seeking evaluator for one registered metric.
Evaluate only visual–narration semantic correspondence; do not grade overall
video quality, aesthetics, editing smoothness, source fidelity, tool use, or
hidden production intent.</span></span></span>
<span id="A2.SS3.p2.pic1.2.2" class="ltx_p ltx_align_left"><span id="A2.SS3.p2.pic1.2.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Immutable inputs.<span id="A2.SS3.p2.pic1.2.2.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_medium"> A shot packet (JSON) with <span id="A2.SS3.p2.pic1.2.2.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">criterion=VNSM</span>,
case and shot IDs, the narration text active over the registered shot
interval, video and manifest SHA-256 digests, sampler and prompt versions, and
model snapshot and decoding configuration; and sampled evidence comprising four
chronologically ordered frames <math id="A2.SS3.p2.pic1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="t_{1}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">t</mi><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">1</mn></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t_{1}</annotation></semantics></math>–<math id="A2.SS3.p2.pic1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="t_{4}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">t</mi><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">4</mn></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t_{4}</annotation></semantics></math> with source timestamps
(<span id="A2.SS3.p2.pic1.2.2.1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">hh:mm:ss</span>) and, on request, one bounded clip. No plan, retrieval
query, similarity score, reference video, method name, or training reward is
supplied.</span></span></span>
<span id="A2.SS3.p2.pic1.2.3" class="ltx_p ltx_align_left"><span id="A2.SS3.p2.pic1.2.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Procedure.<span id="A2.SS3.p2.pic1.2.3.1.1" class="ltx_text"></span></span></span>
<span id="A2.I1" class="ltx_enumerate ltx_align_left" style="--ltx-enum-leftmargin:17pt;">
<span id="A2.I1.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">1.</span> 
<span id="A2.I1.i1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A2.I1.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.I1.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Verify that all four frames, their timestamps, and the narration window
are present and internally consistent. Otherwise set </span><span id="A2.I1.i1.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">status</span><span id="A2.I1.i1.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> to one
registered failure code.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A2.I1.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">2.</span> 
<span id="A2.I1.i2.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A2.I1.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.I1.i2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Decompose the narration into its central visually testable units:
referent, setting, attribute, action, and event. Do not require support for
abstract discourse that cannot be depicted.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A2.I1.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">3.</span> 
<span id="A2.I1.i3.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A2.I1.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.I1.i3.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Inspect every frame in chronological order and record two to four
time-local visible observations before assigning a score. Each observation
must be paired with one supplied frame timestamp.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A2.I1.i4" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">4.</span> 
<span id="A2.I1.i4.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A2.I1.i4.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.I1.i4.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">For each central unit, decide whether it is directly supported, merely
generic/topical, absent, or contradicted. One matching object cannot override
a contradictory action or event.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A2.I1.i5" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">5.</span> 
<span id="A2.I1.i5.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A2.I1.i5.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.I1.i5.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Request the single bounded clip only when motion or temporal order is
necessary to distinguish an action. The clip may cover only the registered
shot interval and cannot introduce outside context.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A2.I1.i6" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">6.</span> 
<span id="A2.I1.i6.p1" class="ltx_para">
<span id="A2.I1.i6.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.I1.i6.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Select exactly one anchored score whose full anchor is satisfied. When
evidence falls between anchors, choose the lower anchor; never interpolate or
invent a new score.</span></span>
</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A2.SS3.p2.pic1.2.4" class="ltx_p ltx_align_left"><span id="A2.SS3.p2.pic1.2.4.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Evidence rules.<span id="A2.SS3.p2.pic1.2.4.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_medium"> A generic presenter, publisher card, or decorative
overlay alone cannot score above 2 (Fair). OCR text counts as visual support
only when the narration is explicitly about displayed text. A correct setting
with the wrong central action is at most 2 (Fair); a direct contradiction
scores 1 (Poor). Evidence outside the registered narration interval is
inadmissible. Never invent a timestamp or infer content absent from the
supplied frames or bounded clip. Missing input, decoding failure, or
harness/provider failure sets <span id="A2.SS3.p2.pic1.2.4.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">status</span> to a failure code; it is missing
evidence, not a Poor score.</span></span></span>
<span id="A2.SS3.p2.pic1.2.5" class="ltx_p ltx_align_left"><span id="A2.SS3.p2.pic1.2.5.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Output.<span id="A2.SS3.p2.pic1.2.5.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_medium"> Return strict JSON only, with no markdown or free-form text.</span></span></span>
</span></span></span></foreignObject></g></g></svg></span>
</div>
<div id="A2.SS3.p3" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent"><span class="ltx_inline-block"><svg id="A2.SS3.p3.pic1" class="ltx_picture" height="771.94" overflow="visible" version="1.1" viewBox="0 0 653.15 771.94" width="653.15"><g style="--ltx-stroke-color:#000000;--ltx-fill-color:#000000;" fill="#000000" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0.4pt" transform="translate(0,771.94) matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 0)"><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#3B7A57;" fill="#3B7A57" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 0 7.01 L 0 764.93 C 0 768.81 3.14 771.94 7.01 771.94 L 646.14 771.94 C 650.01 771.94 653.15 768.81 653.15 764.93 L 653.15 7.01 C 653.15 3.14 650.01 0 646.14 0 L 7.01 0 C 3.14 0 0 3.14 0 7.01 Z"></path></g><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#F7F9FC;" fill="#F7F9FC" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 1.11 7.01 L 1.11 749.56 L 652.04 749.56 L 652.04 7.01 C 652.04 3.75 649.4 1.11 646.14 1.11 L 7.01 1.11 C 3.75 1.11 1.11 3.75 1.11 7.01 Z"></path></g><g fill-opacity="1.0" transform="matrix(1.0 0.0 0.0 1.0 14.89 757.29)"><foreignObject style="--ltx-fo-width:39.17em;--ltx-fo-height:0.69em;--ltx-fo-depth:0.19em;font-size:10pt;" height="12.3" overflow="visible" transform="matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 9.61)" width="542"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_container"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_content">
<span id="A2.SS3.p3.pic1.1" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:39.17em;">
<span id="A2.SS3.p3.pic1.1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.SS3.p3.pic1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#FFFFFF;">Held-Out VNSM Evaluator: Anchors and Output</span></span>
</span></span></span></foreignObject></g><g fill-opacity="1.0" transform="matrix(1.0 0.0 0.0 1.0 14.89 15.61)"><foreignObject style="--ltx-fo-width:45.05em;--ltx-fo-height:52.19em;--ltx-fo-depth:0.19em;font-size:10pt;" height="724.84" overflow="visible" transform="matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 722.15)" width="623.37"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_container"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_content">
<span id="A2.SS3.p3.pic1.2" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:45.05em;">
<span id="A2.SS3.p3.pic1.2.1" class="ltx_p ltx_align_left"><span id="A2.SS3.p3.pic1.2.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Anchored rubric.<span id="A2.SS3.p3.pic1.2.1.1.1" class="ltx_text"></span></span></span>
<span id="A2.I2" class="ltx_itemize ltx_align_left" style="--ltx-enum-leftmargin:17pt;">
<span id="A2.I2.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A2.I2.i1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A2.I2.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.I2.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">4 — Excellent (direct and complete)</span><span id="A2.I2.i1.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">: every central visually
testable referent/action/event is directly visible in the matching interval,
with no material contradiction.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A2.I2.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A2.I2.i2.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A2.I2.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.I2.i2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">3 — Good (specific but partial)</span><span id="A2.I2.i2.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">: the correct subject and scene
are visible and the central referent or action is substantially supported, but
one important attribute, phase, or consequence is not verifiable.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A2.I2.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A2.I2.i3.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A2.I2.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.I2.i3.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">2 — Fair (topical or generic)</span><span id="A2.I2.i3.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">: the imagery is in the correct
broad topic or setting, but the central action, relation, or specific referent
is not visually verified. Generic B-roll belongs here even when aesthetically
apt.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A2.I2.i4" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A2.I2.i4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<span id="A2.I2.i4.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.I2.i4.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">1 — Poor (atmospheric, absent, or contradictory)</span><span id="A2.I2.i4.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">: only color,
mood, or a weak association relates to the narration, or the imagery is
irrelevant, shows the wrong subject/action/event, or materially contradicts
the narration.</span></span>
</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A2.SS3.p3.pic1.2.2" class="ltx_p ltx_align_left"><span id="A2.SS3.p3.pic1.2.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Required JSON fields.<span id="A2.SS3.p3.pic1.2.2.1.1" class="ltx_text"></span></span></span><pre id="A2.SS3.p3.pic1.2.3" class="ltx_verbatim ltx_align_left ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">
{
  "criterion": "VNSM",
  "score": 1|2|3|4,
  "evidence": ["&lt;visible observation&gt;", ...],
  "timestamps": ["&lt;hh:mm:ss&gt;", ...],
  "status": "ok"
}
</pre>
<span id="A2.SS3.p3.pic1.2.4" class="ltx_p ltx_align_left"><span id="A2.SS3.p3.pic1.2.4.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">For <span id="A2.SS3.p3.pic1.2.4.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">status="ok"</span>, <span id="A2.SS3.p3.pic1.2.4.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">score</span> is an allowed anchor, and
<span id="A2.SS3.p3.pic1.2.4.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">evidence</span> contains 2–4 distinct visible observations, each aligned
with one entry of <span id="A2.SS3.p3.pic1.2.4.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">timestamps</span> drawn from the supplied frames.
Otherwise, <span id="A2.SS3.p3.pic1.2.4.1.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">score</span> is null, <span id="A2.SS3.p3.pic1.2.4.1.6" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">evidence</span> and <span id="A2.SS3.p3.pic1.2.4.1.7" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">timestamps</span>
are empty, and <span id="A2.SS3.p3.pic1.2.4.1.8" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">status</span> is exactly one of <span id="A2.SS3.p3.pic1.2.4.1.9" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">missing_input</span>,
<span id="A2.SS3.p3.pic1.2.4.1.10" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">digest_mismatch</span>, <span id="A2.SS3.p3.pic1.2.4.1.11" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">sampler_failure</span>,
<span id="A2.SS3.p3.pic1.2.4.1.12" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">provider_failure</span>, <span id="A2.SS3.p3.pic1.2.4.1.13" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">decode_failure</span>, or
<span id="A2.SS3.p3.pic1.2.4.1.14" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">schema_failure</span>. Case and shot IDs, digests, and version IDs are
bound by the shot packet rather than repeated in the output.</span></span>
</span></span></span></foreignObject></g></g></svg></span>
</div>
<div id="A2.SS3.p4" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A2.SS3.p4.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.SS3.p4.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Deterministic validation and retry.</span>
The evaluator runs at temperature 0 with the frozen decoding parameters shown
in the packet. A deterministic validator checks the <span id="A2.SS3.p4.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">criterion</span> and
<span id="A2.SS3.p4.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">score</span> values, the <span id="A2.SS3.p4.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">status</span>-dependent fields, timestamp
membership, evidence count, and the match between each response and its shot
packet. An invalid response receives one schema-only repair request containing
the validation errors but no new visual evidence. A second invalid response is
recorded as unavailable with <span id="A2.SS3.p4.1.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">schema_failure</span>. No human edits the score
or evidence.</p>
</div>
<div id="A2.SS3.p5" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A2.SS3.p5.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.SS3.p5.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Aggregation and claim gate.</span>
The held-out Claude Opus 5 evaluator judges each registered shot once.
Video-level VNSM is the unweighted mean of rescaled grades over shots with
<span id="A2.SS3.p5.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">status="ok"</span> and is reported only when <math id="A2.SS3.p5.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="|\mathcal{S}|\geq 5" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒮</mi><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><mo>≥</mo><mn>5</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">|\mathcal{S}|\geq 5</annotation></semantics></math>.
Unavailable calls are excluded rather than scored. A second held-out VLM family
independently re-judges the same shots solely to audit agreement, and its grades
do not enter VNSM. We report coverage, eligible-shot count, the two
family-specific means, rank correlation, and Krippendorff’s <math id="A2.SS3.p5.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\alpha" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>α</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\alpha</annotation></semantics></math>. Agreement
below <math id="A2.SS3.p5.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\alpha=0.6" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>α</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0.6</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\alpha=0.6</annotation></semantics></math> blocks a standalone VNSM claim. Before the prompt is frozen,
a disjoint 50-shot development set is used for blinded human correlation and
controlled corruption tests (wrong subject, wrong action, temporal shift, and
generic B-roll). Test tasks never participate in calibration.</p>
</div>
<div id="A2.SS3.p6" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A2.SS3.p6.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A2.SS3.p6.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Training/evaluation separation.</span>
The training-side VLM-Judge is a sampled spotlight audit, used only for reward
features and limited to <span id="A2.SS3.p6.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">visual_impact</span> and <span id="A2.SS3.p6.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">clarity</span>: the
former checks whether the animation is visually engaging in layout and
aesthetics, while the latter checks whether motion and text convey information
without distraction or layout errors. The held-out VNSM evaluator and audit
family instead use final rendered evidence, separately versioned models,
isolated credentials, and prompts unavailable to the training jobs.</p>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="A3" class="ltx_appendix">
<h2 class="ltx_title ltx_title_appendix"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_appendix">Appendix C </span>Experimental Protocol and Reporting</h2>

<section id="A3.SS1" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">C.1 </span>External Baseline Contract</h3>

<div id="A3.SS1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A3.SS1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Task-matched native systems receive the same frozen script, source pool,
duration, aspect ratio, and budget while retaining their released orchestration
and tools. Adapters may translate serialization and export native artifacts,
but may not retrieve assets, rewrite narration, invent plans, add manual edits,
or perform unavailable repairs. We record the plan, call log, artifacts, final
video, failure code, time, and cost. A missing native artifact makes its
trace-dependent metric N/A. Systems requiring semantic adapter work enter the
task-adjacent track and are excluded from the headline matched ranking.
The five component-metric entries average five independent runs over the same
100 held-out tasks, with <math id="A3.SS1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\pm" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mo>±</mo><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\pm</annotation></semantics></math> denoting the standard deviation across runs. Overall
Score instead averages the five reported component means and is shown without
an uncertainty estimate. It is N/A when any component mean is unavailable.
Missing components are neither imputed nor omitted from the denominator.</p>
</div>
<figure id="A3.T6" class="ltx_table">
<figcaption class="ltx_caption"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_table">Table 6: </span>Baseline task-contract audit. Systems satisfying every required
contract element enter the task-matched native-system comparison.</figcaption>

<td id="A3.T6.2.1.2" class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_border_tt" style="padding-left:3.2pt;padding-right:3.2pt;"><span id="A3.T6.2.1.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Paradigm</span></td>

<span id="A3.T6.2.1.3.2.1.2" class="ltx_tr">

<span id="A3.T6.2.1.4.2.1.1" class="ltx_tr">
<span id="A3.T6.2.1.4.2.1.1.1" class="ltx_td ltx_nopad_r ltx_align_center" style="padding-left:3.2pt;padding-right:3.2pt;"><span id="A3.T6.2.1.4.2.1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Shot</span></span></span>
<span id="A3.T6.2.1.4.2.1.2" class="ltx_tr">

</span></span><span id="A3.T6.2.1.4.3" class="ltx_text"></span></td>
<td id="A3.T6.2.1.5" class="ltx_td ltx_align_center ltx_border_tt" style="padding-left:3.2pt;padding-right:3.2pt;"><span id="A3.T6.2.1.5.1" class="ltx_text"></span> <span id="A3.T6.2.1.5.2" class="ltx_text">
<span id="A3.T6.2.1.5.2.1" class="ltx_tabular ltx_align_middle">
<span id="A3.T6.2.1.5.2.1.1" class="ltx_tr">
<span id="A3.T6.2.1.5.2.1.1.1" class="ltx_td ltx_nopad_r ltx_align_center" style="padding-left:3.2pt;padding-right:3.2pt;"><span id="A3.T6.2.1.5.2.1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Trace /</span></span></span>
<span id="A3.T6.2.1.5.2.1.2" class="ltx_tr">
<span id="A3.T6.2.1.5.2.1.2.1" class="ltx_td ltx_nopad_r ltx_align_center" style="padding-left:3.2pt;padding-right:3.2pt;"><span id="A3.T6.2.1.5.2.1.2.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">repair</span></span></span>
</span></span><span id="A3.T6.2.1.5.3" class="ltx_text"></span></td>
<td id="A3.T6.2.1.6" class="ltx_td ltx_align_center ltx_border_tt" style="padding-left:3.2pt;padding-right:3.2pt;"><span id="A3.T6.2.1.6.1" class="ltx_text"></span> <span id="A3.T6.2.1.6.2" class="ltx_text">
<span id="A3.T6.2.1.6.2.1" class="ltx_tabular ltx_align_middle">
<span id="A3.T6.2.1.6.2.1.1" class="ltx_tr">
<span id="A3.T6.2.1.6.2.1.1.1" class="ltx_td ltx_nopad_r ltx_align_center" style="padding-left:3.2pt;padding-right:3.2pt;"><span id="A3.T6.2.1.6.2.1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Fixed</span></span></span>
<span id="A3.T6.2.1.6.2.1.2" class="ltx_tr">
<span id="A3.T6.2.1.6.2.1.2.1" class="ltx_td ltx_nopad_r ltx_align_center" style="padding-left:3.2pt;padding-right:3.2pt;"><span id="A3.T6.2.1.6.2.1.2.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">sources</span></span></span>

<section id="A3.SS2" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">C.2 </span>Plan–Render Visualization Protocol</h3>

<div id="A3.SS2.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A3.SS2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Qualitative examples are selected from registered length, domain, and failure
strata before method identities are revealed. The native-system panel fixes
rows to Crayotter and WeVisCut and uses one common narration and source pool.
Each row shows five rendered keyframes at identical absolute timestamps and a
compact evidence strip restricted to visible properties. Missing frames remain
visibly missing and an invalid delivery retains its terminal failure stage.
Additional systems, when available under the same contract, appear in separate
panels rather than changing the frozen comparison. Visualizations explain the
registered metrics but do not re-score or reorder examples.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A3.SS3" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">C.3 </span>Depth and Real-Tool Diagnostics</h3>

<div id="A3.SS3.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A3.SS3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">For a subset of tasks, the evaluation protocol injects a registered late-stage
fault and records the repair branch <math id="A3.SS3.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\tau^{+}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msup><mi>τ</mi><mo>+</mo></msup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\tau^{+}</annotation></semantics></math>. The shared case ID links the
script, shot plan, original execution, delivered video, and changes made during
repair, allowing recovery behavior to be inspected alongside normal production.</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS3.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A3.SS3.p2.1" class="ltx_p">For horizon <math id="A3.SS3.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="H_{i}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>H</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">H_{i}</annotation></semantics></math> and first failure turn <math id="A3.SS3.p2.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="t_{i}^{\rm fail}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msubsup><mi>t</mi><mi>i</mi><mi>fail</mi></msubsup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t_{i}^{\rm fail}</annotation></semantics></math>,</p>
<table id="A3.E23" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A3.E23.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\operatorname{FailRate}@k=\frac{\sum_{i}\mathbf{1}[H_{i}\geq k]\mathbf{1}[t_{i}^{\rm fail}=k]}{\sum_{i}\mathbf{1}[H_{i}\geq k]}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>FailRate</mi><mo lspace="0.167em">⁡</mo><mi>@</mi></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mo>∑</mo><msub><mrow></mrow><mi>i</mi></msub><mn>𝟏</mn><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mi>H</mi><msub><mrow></mrow><mi>i</mi></msub><mo>≥</mo><mi>k</mi><mo stretchy="false">]</mo><mn>𝟏</mn><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mi>t</mi><msub><mrow></mrow><mi>i</mi></msub><msup><mrow></mrow><mi>fail</mi></msup><mo>=</mo><mi>k</mi><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow><mrow><mo>∑</mo><msub><mrow></mrow><mi>i</mi></msub><mn>𝟏</mn><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mi>H</mi><msub><mrow></mrow><mi>i</mi></msub><mo>≥</mo><mi>k</mi><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mfrac></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\operatorname{FailRate}@k=\frac{\sum_{i}\mathbf{1}[H_{i}\geq k]\mathbf{1}[t_{i}^{\rm fail}=k]}{\sum_{i}\mathbf{1}[H_{i}\geq k]}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(23)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A3.SS3.p2.2" class="ltx_p">Completion and repair at depth <math id="A3.SS3.p2.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="k" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>k</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">k</annotation></semantics></math> use the same eligible denominator. The
proxy–real gap is a paired mean between frozen-fixture replay and production
execution. Unmatched or failed runs are retained in reporting. These depth and
proxy–real diagnostics complete the registered protocol. The experiment tables
report the five registered metrics and the descriptive Overall Score.</p>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="A4" class="ltx_appendix">
<h2 class="ltx_title ltx_title_appendix"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_appendix">Appendix D </span>A Representative Autonomous Tool-Use Flow</h2>

<div id="A4.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A4.p1.1" class="ltx_p">This appendix illustrates the inference-time behavior of WeVisCut with one
complete production trace. The purpose is not to expose the full generated
screenplay or every JSON payload, but to show the closed-loop decision pattern
used by the policy: it first builds a long-horizon production plan, then
executes real tools, observes typed runtime returns, repairs bounded failures,
satisfies missing prerequisites, and terminates only after the video has
actually been delivered.</p>
</div>
<div id="A4.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A4.p2.1" class="ltx_p">The raw trace is stored as <span class="ltx_ref ltx_nolink ltx_path ltx_font_typewriter ltx_ref_self">agent_trace.jsonl</span> and the delivery record as
<span class="ltx_ref ltx_nolink ltx_path ltx_font_typewriter ltx_ref_self">stitch_manifest.json</span>. The transcript below is a faithful, translated
rendering of that trace, organized as</p>
<table id="A4.EGx7" class="ltx_equationgroup ltx_eqn_gather ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody id="A4.Ex10"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A4.Ex10.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\textsc{Thinking}\;\rightarrow\;\textsc{Observation}\;\rightarrow\;\textsc{Tool Call}" display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mtext class="ltx_font_smallcaps">Thinking</mtext><mo lspace="0.558em" rspace="0.558em" stretchy="false">→</mo><mtext class="ltx_font_smallcaps">Observation</mtext><mo lspace="0.558em" rspace="0.558em" stretchy="false">→</mo><mtext class="ltx_font_smallcaps">Tool Call</mtext></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\textsc{Thinking}\;\rightarrow\;\textsc{Observation}\;\rightarrow\;\textsc{Tool Call}</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
<tbody id="A4.Ex11"><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A4.Ex11.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle\rightarrow\;\textsc{Runtime Return}\;\rightarrow\;\textsc{Next Decision}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo rspace="0.558em" stretchy="false">→</mo><mtext class="ltx_font_smallcaps">Runtime Return</mtext><mo lspace="0.558em" rspace="0.558em" stretchy="false">→</mo><mtext class="ltx_font_smallcaps">Next Decision</mtext></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle\rightarrow\;\textsc{Runtime Return}\;\rightarrow\;\textsc{Next Decision}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A4.p2.2" class="ltx_p">The <span id="A4.p2.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps">Thinking</span> field reports the deliberation the policy emits before
committing to a tool action. It is part of the recorded action interface rather
than hidden reasoning: every claim it makes about the world is either grounded
in a previous typed return or is falsified by the next one, which is precisely
what makes the trace usable as training supervision.</p>
</div>
<div id="A4.p3" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent"><span class="ltx_inline-block"><svg id="A4.p3.pic1" class="ltx_picture" height="7274.1" overflow="visible" version="1.1" viewBox="0 0 653.15 7274.1" width="653.15"><g style="--ltx-stroke-color:#000000;--ltx-fill-color:#000000;" fill="#000000" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0.4pt" transform="translate(0,7274.1) matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 0)"><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#2A5C91;" fill="#2A5C91" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 0 7.01 L 0 7267.09 C 0 7270.97 3.14 7274.1 7.01 7274.1 L 646.14 7274.1 C 650.01 7274.1 653.15 7270.97 653.15 7267.09 L 653.15 7.01 C 653.15 3.14 650.01 0 646.14 0 L 7.01 0 C 3.14 0 0 3.14 0 7.01 Z"></path></g><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#F7F9FC;" fill="#F7F9FC" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 1.11 7.01 L 1.11 7251.72 L 652.04 7251.72 L 652.04 7.01 C 652.04 3.75 649.4 1.11 646.14 1.11 L 7.01 1.11 C 3.75 1.11 1.11 3.75 1.11 7.01 Z"></path></g><g fill-opacity="1.0" transform="matrix(1.0 0.0 0.0 1.0 14.89 7259.45)"><foreignObject style="--ltx-fo-width:39.17em;--ltx-fo-height:0.69em;--ltx-fo-depth:0.19em;font-size:10pt;" height="12.3" overflow="visible" transform="matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 9.61)" width="542"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_container"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_content">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.1" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:39.17em;">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#FFFFFF;">Representative Autonomous Trace: Plan–Act–Repair–Deliver</span></span>
</span></span></span></foreignObject></g><g fill-opacity="1.0" transform="matrix(1.0 0.0 0.0 1.0 14.89 15.69)"><foreignObject style="--ltx-fo-width:45.05em;--ltx-fo-height:522.1em;--ltx-fo-depth:0.2em;font-size:10pt;" height="7227.07" overflow="visible" transform="matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 7224.31)" width="623.37"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_container"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_content"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.2" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:45.05em;">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p96" class="ltx_para">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p96.1" class="ltx_p ltx_align_left"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p96.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Run card.<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p96.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_medium">
The run identifier is
<span class="ltx_ref ltx_nolink ltx_path ltx_font_typewriter ltx_ref_self">aicut_20260824_152401_9f7f9d</span>.
The input is a fixed long-form narration about aircraft science and
engineering, tokenized by the runtime into 51 semantic units
(<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p96.1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">u01</span>–<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p96.1.1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">u51</span>). The finished project contains 6 screenplay
segments, 30 realized shots, 16 spotlight shots, and 3 background-music tracks.
The policy runs for 16 tool turns over 31 minutes of wall-clock time and
delivers a 395.0-second video:</span></span></span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p96.2" class="ltx_p ltx_align_left ltx_align_center"><span class="ltx_ref ltx_nolink ltx_path ltx_font_typewriter ltx_ref_self" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">final_video_with_bgm_20260824_155554.mp4</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">1. Build the high-level production plan</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Thinking.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p2.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
I hold nothing but the narration. Every downstream tool in this runtime is
gated on structure that does not exist yet, so the only admissible first action
is the one that turns free text into a typed screenplay. Two choices matter
here. First, granularity: the narration runs several hundred seconds, and a
segment count near six keeps each act long enough to carry an argument while
still giving the shot planner meaningful boundaries to respect. Second, I
should request the global music style now rather than at delivery time, because
the stitcher will need a music query long after the narration’s tone is still
in context, and recovering that tone later from rendered shots would be lossy.
I also pin narration order and full-script coverage, since any dropped span
becomes a semantic hole that no later repair tool is able to detect.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p3" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p3.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p3.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Observation.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p3.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
Only the raw narration is available. No shot plan, assets, audio, templates,
rendered paths, or delivery artifacts exist.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p4" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p4.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p4.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Call.</span></span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p4.2" class="ltx_listing ltx_lstlisting ltx_framed ltx_framed_rectangle ltx_listing" style="--ltx-bg-color:#F1F4F8;--ltx-border-color:#CDD5DF;"><span class="ltx_listing_data"><a href="data:text/plain;base64,VG9vbF9TZWdtZW50QXJ0aWNsZSgKICAgIG51bV9zZWdtZW50c190YXJnZXQ9NiwKICAgIHNlZ21lbnRfZ3JhbnVsYXJpdHk9Im1lZGl1bSIsCiAgICBwcmVzZXJ2ZV9uYXJyYXRpb25fb3JkZXI9VHJ1ZSwKICAgIGNvdmVyX2Z1bGxfc2NyaXB0PVRydWUsCiAgICBuZWVkX211c2ljX3N0eWxlPVRydWUKKQ==" download="">⬇</a></span>
<span id="lstnumberx1" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Tool_SegmentArticle</span><span id="lstnumberx1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">(</span>
</span>
<span id="lstnumberx2" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">    </span><span id="lstnumberx2.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">num_segments_target</span><span id="lstnumberx2.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">=6,</span>
</span>
<span id="lstnumberx3" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">    </span><span id="lstnumberx3.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">segment_granularity</span><span id="lstnumberx3.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">="</span><span id="lstnumberx3.4" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">medium</span><span id="lstnumberx3.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">",</span>
</span>
<span id="lstnumberx4" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx4.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">    </span><span id="lstnumberx4.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">preserve_narration_order</span><span id="lstnumberx4.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">=</span><span id="lstnumberx4.4" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">True</span><span id="lstnumberx4.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">,</span>
</span>
<span id="lstnumberx5" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx5.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">    </span><span id="lstnumberx5.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">cover_full_script</span><span id="lstnumberx5.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">=</span><span id="lstnumberx5.4" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">True</span><span id="lstnumberx5.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">,</span>
</span>
<span id="lstnumberx6" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx6.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">    </span><span id="lstnumberx6.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">need_music_style</span><span id="lstnumberx6.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">=</span><span id="lstnumberx6.4" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">True</span>
</span>
<span id="lstnumberx7" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx7.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">)</span>
</span>
</span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p5" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p5.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p5.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Return.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p5.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p5.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">status=success</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p5.1.4" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">. The runtime returns a six-segment outline — a
prologue (“Looking Up in Wonder”), four core acts (“A Precision Airborne
Ecosystem”, “Extreme Lightweighting and Flexible Wisdom”, “Eyes of Technology
and Invisible Guardians”, “From Adventure to Everyday”), and a coda (“A Love
Letter to the Sky”) — together with a per-segment narration script, a
planner strategy, and the global music style: “epic orchestral, piano
lead, strings underneath, tempo moving from slow to fast, grand and warm”.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p6" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p6.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p6.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Next decision.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p6.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
Convert the outline into executable shot-level production cards.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p7" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p7.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p7.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">2. Expand the plan into shot-level production cards</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p8" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p8.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p8.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Thinking.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p8.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
The segment outline is an argument, not a shot list. Nothing downstream can
consume it: retrieval needs a visual query per shot, synthesis needs a vocal
script per shot, and the renderer needs durations and identifiers. I set the
shot target well above what I expect to keep, because the planner is allowed to
merge and drop but not to invent coverage, and an over-request costs nothing at
this stage while an under-request silently truncates the tail of the script. I
forbid repeated visual queries, since duplicate queries collapse to the same
retrieved asset and produce visible repetition that no per-shot quality check
will flag — the failure only becomes obvious in the stitched cut, which is
far too late to fix cheaply. I also want spotlight marks assigned here rather
than later, because the decoration and rendering budget is the scarcest
resource in the run and I would rather allocate it from a global view of the
script than greedily, shot by shot.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p9" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p9.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p9.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Observation.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p9.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
A segment-level plan exists, but the runtime still lacks shot IDs, visual
queries, durations, spotlight marks, and coverage records.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p10" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p10.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p10.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Call.</span></span>

<span id="lstnumberx10" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx10.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">    </span><span id="lstnumberx10.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">num_shots_target</span><span id="lstnumberx10.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">=50,</span>
</span>
<span id="lstnumberx11" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx11.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">    </span><span id="lstnumberx11.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">planning_policy</span><span id="lstnumberx11.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">={</span>
</span>
<span id="lstnumberx12" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx12.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">        </span><span id="lstnumberx12.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"</span><span id="lstnumberx12.3" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">preserve_narration_order</span><span id="lstnumberx12.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">":</span><span id="lstnumberx12.5" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> </span><span id="lstnumberx12.6" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">True</span><span id="lstnumberx12.7" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">,</span>

</span>
<span id="lstnumberx15" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx15.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">)</span>
</span>
</span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p11" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p11.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p11.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Return.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p11.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p11.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">status=success</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p11.1.4" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">. The planner realizes 30 shots spanning 397.4 planned
seconds, distributed 2/2/2/7/10/7 across the six segments, and marks 16 of them
as spotlight shots. The union of </span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p11.1.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">covered_unit_ids</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p11.1.6" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> is

uncovered narration unit.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p12" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p12.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p12.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Next decision.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p12.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
Materialize the planned shots with real assets and narration audio.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p13" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p13.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p13.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">3. Execute batched visual retrieval and narration synthesis</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p14" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p14.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p14.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Thinking.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p14.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
Retrieval and text-to-speech are the two slowest operations in the pipeline and
they are independent per shot, so issuing them one shot at a time would waste
most of the run’s wall-clock budget on serialization. I dispatch all 30 shots
in a single batch. This is also the first turn where the plan meets the real
asset library, which means it is the first turn where my assumptions can be
falsified: a visual query that reads well as prose may still retrieve nothing
usable. I therefore care less about the average match score in the return than
about whether any shot comes back with an empty candidate set, because a
partial batch would force me to choose between re-querying and accepting a hole
in the cut.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p15" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p15.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p15.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Observation.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p15.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
The shot plan is complete, but no media artifacts exist.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p16" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p16.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p16.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Call.</span></span>
