<span id="lstnumberx16" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx16.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Tool_BatchVisualAudio</span><span id="lstnumberx16.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">(</span>
</span>
<span id="lstnumberx17" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx17.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">    </span><span id="lstnumberx17.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">shot_ids</span><span id="lstnumberx17.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">=["1",</span><span id="lstnumberx17.4" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> </span><span id="lstnumberx17.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"2",</span><span id="lstnumberx17.6" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> </span><span id="lstnumberx17.7" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">...,</span><span id="lstnumberx17.8" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> </span><span id="lstnumberx17.9" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"30"]</span>
</span>
<span id="lstnumberx18" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx18.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">)</span>
</span>
</span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p17" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p17.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p17.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Return.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p17.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p17.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">status=success</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p17.1.4" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> for all 30 shots. Every shot receives a clip path, a
source duration, a match score, and a non-empty candidate set — for example
shot 2 retrieves at </span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p17.1.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">match_score</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p17.1.6" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> </span><math id="A4.p3.pic1.p17.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="=0.592" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">=</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0.592</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">=0.592</annotation></semantics></math><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p17.1.7" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> from 12 candidates and
shot 5 at </span><math id="A4.p3.pic1.p17.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="0.611" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0.611</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0.611</annotation></semantics></math><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p17.1.8" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> from 12 candidates, while the weakest, shot 1, still returns
</span><math id="A4.p3.pic1.p17.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="0.452" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0.452</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0.452</annotation></semantics></math><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p17.1.9" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> from 5 candidates. All shots report
</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p17.1.10" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">playlist_ready=true</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p17.1.11" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">. The batch takes roughly 14 minutes, the single
most expensive turn in the run.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p18" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p18.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p18.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Next decision.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p18.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
Spend the decoration and rendering-template budget only on spotlight shots.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p19" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p19.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p19.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">4. Decorate the spotlight shots</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p20" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p20.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p20.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Thinking.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p20.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
Decoration is what separates a slideshow from an edited video, but it is also
the most expensive thing I can ask for, both in template rendering and in the
downstream quality checks it triggers. The 16 spotlight marks from step 2 are
exactly the allocation decision I already made, so I honor them and set
</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p20.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">spotlight_only</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p20.1.4" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> rather than re-deciding now with less context than the
planner had. I ask for slot verification in the same call, because a template
whose slots are filled but semantically wrong is worse than no template at
all: it renders cleanly, passes structural checks, and puts an incorrect
caption on screen.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p21" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p21.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p21.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Observation.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p21.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
Shot assets and narration audio exist for all 30 shots, and the 16 spotlight
IDs are known from the plan.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p22" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p22.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p22.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Call.</span></span>

</span>
<span id="lstnumberx22" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx22.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">    </span><span id="lstnumberx22.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">template_policy</span><span id="lstnumberx22.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">={</span>

<span id="lstnumberx24" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx24.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">        </span><span id="lstnumberx24.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"</span><span id="lstnumberx24.3" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">fill_slots</span><span id="lstnumberx24.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">":</span><span id="lstnumberx24.5" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> </span><span id="lstnumberx24.6" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">True</span><span id="lstnumberx24.7" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">,</span>

</span>
<span id="lstnumberx26" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx26.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">        </span><span id="lstnumberx26.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"</span><span id="lstnumberx26.3" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">spotlight_only</span><span id="lstnumberx26.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">":</span><span id="lstnumberx26.5" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> </span><span id="lstnumberx26.6" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">True</span>
</span>
<span id="lstnumberx27" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx27.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">    </span><span id="lstnumberx27.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">}</span>
</span>
<span id="lstnumberx28" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx28.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">)</span>
</span>
</span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p23" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p23.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p23.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Return.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p23.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p23.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">status=success</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p23.1.4" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">, </span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p23.1.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">decorated_count=16</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p23.1.6" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">,
</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p23.1.7" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">failed_count=0</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p23.1.8" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">, </span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p23.1.9" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">spotlight_count=16</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p23.1.10" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">. Templates are selected
per rhetorical role: </span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p23.1.11" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">hook_title_intro</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p23.1.12" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> for the opening shot,
</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p23.1.13" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">definition_card</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p23.1.14" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> for the Bernoulli explanation,
</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p23.1.15" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">key_takeaway</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p23.1.16" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> for the materials act, </span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p23.1.17" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">analogy_card</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p23.1.18" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> for the
winglet–rowing-blade comparison, and </span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p23.1.19" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">historical_moment</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p23.1.20" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> for the
aviation-history shot. Critically, </span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p23.1.21" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">verified_count=0</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p23.1.22" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">: slot
verification was requested but produced no verdicts, and every
</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p23.1.23" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">verify_result</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p23.1.24" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> is an empty object.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p24" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p24.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p24.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Next decision.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p24.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
The decoration is structurally complete but semantically unverified. Inspect
and improve the plan before paying for the final render.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p25" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p25.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p25.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">5. Encounter a quality-warning state</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p26" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p26.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p26.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Thinking.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p26.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
The zero verification count from the previous return is the loose thread in
this run. I have 16 decorated shots that nothing has actually judged, and the
render stage will happily bake whatever text is in those slots into the frames.
Rendering first and inspecting afterwards would be the expensive ordering, so I
inspect now, over all 30 shots rather than only the decorated ones, since a
visual mismatch on a plain shot is just as damaging in the final cut. I scope
the repair to the two dimensions that decoration can actually move —
decoration quality and visual match — and request minimal repair with an
immediate re-judge, so that whatever the tool changes is validated in the same
call instead of drifting unchecked into the render.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p27" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p27.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p27.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Observation.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p27.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
The decorated plan carries no verification verdicts.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p28" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p28.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p28.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Call.</span></span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p28.2" class="ltx_listing ltx_lstlisting ltx_framed ltx_framed_rectangle ltx_listing" style="--ltx-bg-color:#F1F4F8;--ltx-border-color:#CDD5DF;"><span class="ltx_listing_data"><a href="data:text/plain;base64,VG9vbF9TdGFnZTREaW1lbnNpb25hbFJlcGFpcigKICAgIGZhaWxlZF9zaG90X2lkcz1bIjEiLCAiMiIsIC4uLiwgIjMwIl0sCiAgICB0YXJnZXRfZGltZW5zaW9ucz1bImRlY29yYXRpb25fcXVhbGl0eSIsICJ2aXN1YWxfbWF0Y2giXSwKICAgIG1pbmltYWxfcmVwYWlyPVRydWUsCiAgICByZWp1ZGdlX2FmdGVyX3JlcGFpcj1UcnVlLAogICAgcmVwYWlyX3JvdW5kPTAKKQ==" download="">⬇</a></span>

</span>
<span id="lstnumberx30" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx30.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">    </span><span id="lstnumberx30.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">failed_shot_ids</span><span id="lstnumberx30.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">=["1",</span><span id="lstnumberx30.4" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> </span><span id="lstnumberx30.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"2",</span><span id="lstnumberx30.6" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> </span><span id="lstnumberx30.7" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">...,</span><span id="lstnumberx30.8" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> </span><span id="lstnumberx30.9" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"30"],</span>
</span>
<span id="lstnumberx31" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx31.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">    </span><span id="lstnumberx31.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">target_dimensions</span><span id="lstnumberx31.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">=["</span><span id="lstnumberx31.4" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">decoration_quality</span><span id="lstnumberx31.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">",</span><span id="lstnumberx31.6" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> </span><span id="lstnumberx31.7" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"</span><span id="lstnumberx31.8" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">visual_match</span><span id="lstnumberx31.9" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"],</span>
</span>
<span id="lstnumberx32" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx32.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">    </span><span id="lstnumberx32.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">minimal_repair</span><span id="lstnumberx32.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">=</span><span id="lstnumberx32.4" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">True</span><span id="lstnumberx32.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">,</span>

<span id="lstnumberx35" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx35.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">)</span>
</span>
</span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p29" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p29.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p29.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Return.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p29.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p29.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">status=completed_with_warnings</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p29.1.4" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> after 189.9 seconds:
</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p29.1.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">passed_count=0</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p29.1.6" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">, </span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p29.1.7" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">failed_count=30</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p29.1.8" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">. Every shot remains below
the strict quality threshold.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p30" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p30.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p30.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Next decision.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p30.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
A blanket failure over all 30 shots indicates missing evidence rather than
providing a per-shot defect report. Produce explicit self-reflection findings
before attempting another patch.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p31" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p31.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p31.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">6. Hit a typed precondition error</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p32" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p32.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p32.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Thinking.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p32.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
I want to patch the plan against the reflection findings, and reward shaping is
the augmentation I would like applied so that both passing and failing shots
receive graded per-dimension scores rather than a binary verdict. What I am
about to do, however, is issue synthetic issue identifiers of my own invention.
This is worth recording as an error rather than hiding, because it is the exact
mistake the runtime’s typed preconditions exist to catch: I am attempting to
repair against evidence I have not yet collected.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p33" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p33.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p33.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Observation.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p33.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">

</span>

<span id="lstnumberx45" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx45.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">    </span><span id="lstnumberx45.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">target_shot_ids</span><span id="lstnumberx45.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">=["1",</span><span id="lstnumberx45.4" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> </span><span id="lstnumberx45.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"2",</span><span id="lstnumberx45.6" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> </span><span id="lstnumberx45.7" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"3",</span><span id="lstnumberx45.8" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> </span><span id="lstnumberx45.9" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"4",</span><span id="lstnumberx45.10" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> </span><span id="lstnumberx45.11" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"5"],</span>

<span id="lstnumberx47" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx47.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">    </span><span id="lstnumberx47.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">requires_downstream_propagation_hint</span><span id="lstnumberx47.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">=</span><span id="lstnumberx47.4" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">True</span>

<span id="lstnumberx48" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx48.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">)</span>
</span>
</span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p35" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p35.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p35.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Return.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p35.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p35.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">status=blocked_precondition</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p35.1.4" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">,
</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p35.1.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">missing=["self_reflect_issues"]</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p35.1.6" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">. The runtime rejects the call with
“insufficient preconditions for Tool_SelfReflect_Patch”.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p36" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p36.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p36.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Next decision.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p36.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
Treat the rejection as an instruction rather than a failure: run reflection
first and patch against the identifiers it actually returns.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p37" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p37.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p37.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">7. Generate the missing self-reflection evidence</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p38" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p38.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p38.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Thinking.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p38.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
The precondition told me exactly which object is missing, so this turn is fully
determined — the only real choice left is what to inspect for. I widen the
focus beyond decoration to the five dimensions where an error would be
unrecoverable after rendering: script coverage, shot rhythm, visual-query
alignment, spotlight ratio, and duplication. I deliberately switch the
augmentation strategy from reward shaping to strict semantic coverage. Reward
shaping produces a smoother signal, but at this moment I do not need a smoother
signal. I need a judge that would rather fail a shot than let a semantic
omission through, because a missed narration unit cannot be repaired once the
timeline is composed.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p39" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p39.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p39.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Observation.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p39.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
The patch tool is blocked, and no reflection object exists.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p40" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p40.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p40.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Call.</span></span>

id="lstnumberx61.17" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">over</span><span id="lstnumberx61.18" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space </span>
<span id="lstnumberx62" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx62.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">                  </span><span id="lstnumberx62.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">omission</span><span id="lstnumberx62.3" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> </span><span id="lstnumberx62.4" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">pass</span><span id="lstnumberx62.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">."</span>
</span>
<span id="lstnumberx63" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx63.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">    </span><span id="lstnumberx63.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">}</span>
</span>
<span id="lstnumberx64" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx64.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">)</span>
</span>
</span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p41" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p41.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p41.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Return.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p41.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p41.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">status=needs_fix</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p41.1.4" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">, </span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p41.1.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">passed=false</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p41.1.6" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">,
</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p41.1.7" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">overall_score</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p41.1.8" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> </span><math id="A4.p3.pic1.p41.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="=0.70" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">=</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0.70</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">=0.70</annotation></semantics></math><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p41.1.9" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">. The judge emits 13 concrete issues: 11
</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p41.1.10" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">decoration_quality</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p41.1.11" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> findings (shots 5, 6, 7, 10, 11, 14, 16, 21, 23,
26, 28) and 2 </span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p41.1.12" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">visual_match</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p41.1.13" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> findings (shots 14 and 28), all at medium
severity, with </span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p41.1.14" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">suggested_fix="redecorate"</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p41.1.15" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">. The summary reads
“13 decoration-quality problems found”, and the state now records
</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p41.1.16" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">repair_history=[{round: 0, passed: false, issue_count: 13}]</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p41.1.17" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p42" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p42.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p42.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Next decision.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p42.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
Patch exactly these 13 issues. The blanket 30-shot failure of step 5 has been
resolved into a bounded, addressable defect list.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p43" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p43.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p43.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">8. Patch the plan against the returned issue identifiers</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p44" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p44.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p44.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Thinking.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p44.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
Now I can issue the call I attempted two turns ago, but with the identifiers
the judge actually produced instead of ones I made up. I keep the strict
coverage strategy so that the patch is evaluated by the same standard that
produced the findings. Switching strategies mid-repair would mean patching
against one rubric and being graded by another. I set minimal repair, because
the failures are concentrated in decoration slots and visual queries, and any
edit that ripples into narration text would invalidate the audio I already
synthesized in step 3 at a cost of 14 minutes. I request downstream propagation
hints so the runtime marks which artifacts the patch has invalidated rather
than leaving me to infer it.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p45" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p45.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p45.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Observation.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p45.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
Thirteen typed issues exist over 13 distinct shots.</span></span>
</span>

<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p47" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p47.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p47.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Return.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p47.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p47.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">status=patched</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p47.1.4" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">, </span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p47.1.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">repair_applied=true</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p47.1.6" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">. The patch is indeed
localized: visual queries are sharpened (shot 3’s query gains the explicit
“conveying precision and complexity” qualifier), and shot 2’s duration
is re-estimated from 61.11 s to 60.70 s. Narration scripts, segment
boundaries, and spotlight assignments are left untouched, so the synthesized
audio remains valid.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p48" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p48.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p48.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Next decision.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p48.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
Re-run decoration so the repaired shots pick up new templates and slots.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p49" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p49.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p49.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">9. Re-decorate under the repaired plan</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p50" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p50.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p50.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Thinking.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p50.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
The patch changed the plan, not the rendered overlays, so the decorations
currently in state were selected against text that no longer exists. I re-run
decoration over the full spotlight set rather than only the 13 patched shots:
template selection is a global assignment, and if a patched shot now claims a
template that an unpatched neighbour is already using, restricting the call to
the patched subset would leave that collision in place. The cost is the same
either way, since decoration is cheap relative to rendering.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p51" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p51.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p51.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Observation.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p51.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
The plan has been patched but the spotlight decorations still reflect the
pre-patch text.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p52" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p52.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p52.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Call.</span></span>

<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p53" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">

pressure, lower surface slower and higher pressure”) instead of only the upper
one. Shot 5’s takeaways are compressed from full clauses into three scannable
phrases. Shot 6 moves from a generic </span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p53.1.9" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">overlay</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p53.1.10" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> to a

</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p53.1.13" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">historical_moment_card</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p53.1.14" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> template.</span></span>

<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p54" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">

Re-judge the repaired, re-decorated state.</span></span>

<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p55" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p55.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p55.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">10. Re-judge all shots against the full dimension set</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p56" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p56.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p56.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Thinking.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p56.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
This is the verification half of the repair loop, and I want it against all
five delivery dimensions rather than the two I repaired, because a decoration
edit can break timing alignment even when it improves decoration quality. I
hold the threshold at the strict 0.75 and focus the judge on decoration slots,
which is where the patch actually landed.</span></span>

<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p57" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">

<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p59" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p59.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p59.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Return.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p59.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">

<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p60" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p60.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p60.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Next decision.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p60.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
The zero elapsed time is the informative part: the judge did not re-evaluate,
it replayed a cached verdict. Two of the five requested dimensions
(</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p60.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">render_integrity</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p60.1.4" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> and </span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p60.1.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">timing_alignment</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p60.1.6" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">) cannot be scored
before a render exists, so this verdict is structurally unable to improve at
this stage.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p61" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p61.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p61.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">11. Probe whether the failure is real or structural</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p62" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p62.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p62.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Thinking.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p62.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
Before I spend the rest of the repair budget, I need to distinguish a genuine
quality failure from a stage-ordering artifact. I re-issue the step 5 repair
verbatim. If the state has actually changed, the tool should now do work and
take time. If it returns instantly with the same counts, the verdict is not
tracking my edits and further repair at this stage is pure waste.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p63" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p63.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p63.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Observation.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p63.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
The re-judge reports the same blanket failure it reported before any repair.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p64" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p64.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p64.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Call.</span></span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p64.2" class="ltx_listing ltx_lstlisting ltx_framed ltx_framed_rectangle ltx_listing" style="--ltx-bg-color:#F1F4F8;--ltx-border-color:#CDD5DF;"><span class="ltx_listing_data"><a href="data:text/plain;base64,VG9vbF9TdGFnZTREaW1lbnNpb25hbFJlcGFpcigKICAgIGZhaWxlZF9zaG90X2lkcz1bIjEiLCAiMiIsIC4uLiwgIjMwIl0sCiAgICB0YXJnZXRfZGltZW5zaW9ucz1bImRlY29yYXRpb25fcXVhbGl0eSIsICJ2aXN1YWxfbWF0Y2giXSwKICAgIG1pbmltYWxfcmVwYWlyPVRydWUsCiAgICByZWp1ZGdlX2FmdGVyX3JlcGFpcj1UcnVlLAogICAgcmVwYWlyX3JvdW5kPTAKKQ==" download="">⬇</a></span>
<span id="lstnumberx96" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx96.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Tool_Stage4DimensionalRepair</span><span id="lstnumberx96.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">(</span>
</span>
<span id="lstnumberx97" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx97.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">    </span><span id="lstnumberx97.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">failed_shot_ids</span><span id="lstnumberx97.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">=["1",</span><span id="lstnumberx97.4" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> </span><span id="lstnumberx97.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"2",</span><span id="lstnumberx97.6" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> </span><span id="lstnumberx97.7" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">...,</span><span id="lstnumberx97.8" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> </span><span id="lstnumberx97.9" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"30"],</span>
</span>
<span id="lstnumberx98" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx98.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">    </span><span id="lstnumberx98.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">target_dimensions</span><span id="lstnumberx98.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">=["</span><span id="lstnumberx98.4" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">decoration_quality</span><span id="lstnumberx98.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">",</span><span id="lstnumberx98.6" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> </span><span id="lstnumberx98.7" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"</span><span id="lstnumberx98.8" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">visual_match</span><span id="lstnumberx98.9" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"],</span>
</span>
<span id="lstnumberx99" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx99.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">    </span><span id="lstnumberx99.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">minimal_repair</span><span id="lstnumberx99.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">=</span><span id="lstnumberx99.4" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">True</span><span id="lstnumberx99.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">,</span>
</span>
<span id="lstnumberx100" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx100.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">    </span><span id="lstnumberx100.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">rejudge_after_repair</span><span id="lstnumberx100.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">=</span><span id="lstnumberx100.4" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">True</span><span id="lstnumberx100.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">,</span>
</span>
<span id="lstnumberx101" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx101.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">    </span><span id="lstnumberx101.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">repair_round</span><span id="lstnumberx101.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">=0</span>
</span>
<span id="lstnumberx102" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx102.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">)</span>
</span>
</span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p65" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p65.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p65.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Return.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p65.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p65.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">status=completed_with_warnings</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p65.1.4" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">, </span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p65.1.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">passed_count=0</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p65.1.6" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">,
</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p65.1.7" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">failed_count=30</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p65.1.8" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">, </span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p65.1.9" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">_elapsed_sec=0.0</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p65.1.10" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> — identical counts,
identical zero cost. The hypothesis is confirmed: the warning is structural.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p66" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p66.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p66.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Next decision.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p66.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
Make one final, explicitly budgeted repair attempt so that the runtime, not the
policy, decides when to stop.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p67" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p67.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p67.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">12. Exhaust the repair budget deliberately</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p68" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p68.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p68.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Thinking.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p68.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
I could loop here indefinitely, and that is precisely the failure mode I must
avoid: a repair loop that never converges consumes the entire run and delivers
nothing. So I escalate rather than repeat — I declare this
</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p68.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">repair_round=2</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p68.1.4" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">, the last one the runtime permits, and widen the
target to all five dimensions so that if any residual defect is genuinely
fixable at plan level, this call has the broadest possible chance to fix it.
Setting the round explicitly hands the stopping decision to the runtime’s
budget accounting instead of to my own judgment, which is the safer place for
it.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p69" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p69.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p69.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Observation.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p69.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
Two repair calls have produced no state change at zero cost.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p70" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p70.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p70.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Call.</span></span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p70.2" class="ltx_listing ltx_lstlisting ltx_framed ltx_framed_rectangle ltx_listing" style="--ltx-bg-color:#F1F4F8;--ltx-border-color:#CDD5DF;"><span class="ltx_listing_data"><a href="data:text/plain;base64," download="">⬇</a></span>
<span id="lstnumberx103" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx103.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Tool_Stage4DimensionalRepair</span><span id="lstnumberx103.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">(</span>
</span>
<span id="lstnumberx104" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx104.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">    </span><span id="lstnumberx104.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">failed_shot_ids</span><span id="lstnumberx104.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">=["1",</span><span id="lstnumberx104.4" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> </span><span id="lstnumberx104.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"2",</span><span id="lstnumberx104.6" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> </span><span id="lstnumberx104.7" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">...,</span><span id="lstnumberx104.8" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> </span><span id="lstnumberx104.9" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"30"],</span>
</span>
<span id="lstnumberx105" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx105.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">    </span><span id="lstnumberx105.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">target_dimensions</span><span id="lstnumberx105.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">=["</span><span id="lstnumberx105.4" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">visual_match</span><span id="lstnumberx105.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">",</span><span id="lstnumberx105.6" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> </span><span id="lstnumberx105.7" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"</span><span id="lstnumberx105.8" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">audio_sync</span><span id="lstnumberx105.9" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">",</span><span id="lstnumberx105.10" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> </span><span id="lstnumberx105.11" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"</span><span id="lstnumberx105.12" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">decoration_quality</span><span id="lstnumberx105.13" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">",</span>
</span>
<span id="lstnumberx106" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx106.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">                       </span><span id="lstnumberx106.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"</span><span id="lstnumberx106.3" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">timing_alignment</span><span id="lstnumberx106.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">",</span><span id="lstnumberx106.5" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> </span><span id="lstnumberx106.6" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"</span><span id="lstnumberx106.7" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">render_integrity</span><span id="lstnumberx106.8" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"],</span>
</span>
<span id="lstnumberx107" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx107.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">    </span><span id="lstnumberx107.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">minimal_repair</span><span id="lstnumberx107.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">=</span><span id="lstnumberx107.4" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">True</span><span id="lstnumberx107.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">,</span>
</span>
<span id="lstnumberx108" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx108.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">    </span><span id="lstnumberx108.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">rejudge_after_repair</span><span id="lstnumberx108.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">=</span><span id="lstnumberx108.4" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">True</span><span id="lstnumberx108.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">,</span>
</span>
<span id="lstnumberx109" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx109.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">    </span><span id="lstnumberx109.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">repair_round</span><span id="lstnumberx109.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">=2</span>
</span>
<span id="lstnumberx110" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx110.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">)</span>
</span>
</span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p71" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p71.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p71.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Return.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p71.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p71.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">status=budget_exhausted</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p71.1.4" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">: “the repair limit of 2 has been
reached; remaining warnings will not be repaired and current quality is treated
as passing (rejection 1 of 2)”.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p72" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p72.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p72.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Next decision.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p72.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
The quality gate is closed by budget rather than by score. Stop repairing and
move to delivery.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p73" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p73.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p73.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">13. Attempt delivery and learn the real blocker</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p74" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p74.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p74.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Thinking.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p74.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
With the gate closed I go for the final artifact. I set
</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p74.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">final_gate_required</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p74.1.4" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> so the runtime enforces its own delivery
contract rather than trusting my belief that 30 shots are approved, and I
pre-declare the audio mix — background music at half volume, ducked under the
voice track — because the narration is the payload and music that competes
with it would ruin an otherwise correct cut. I expect this call to succeed, and
if it does not, its rejection will tell me exactly what the state is still
missing.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p75" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p75.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p75.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Observation.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p75.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">

<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p77" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p77.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p77.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Return.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p77.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p77.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">status=blocked_precondition</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p77.1.4" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">,
</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p77.1.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">missing=["timeline_render", "bgm", "rendered_path_ready:0/30"]</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p77.1.6" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p78" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p78.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p78.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Next decision.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p78.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
This is the decisive observation of the run, and it retroactively explains
steps 10–12: </span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p78.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">rendered_path_ready:0/30</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p78.1.4" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> means no shot has ever been
rendered, which is why </span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p78.1.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">render_integrity</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p78.1.6" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> could never pass and why the
repair loop kept failing on a defect that plan-level edits could not reach. The
correct action was never more repair — it was to satisfy the two unmet
prerequisites, timeline rendering and background music, in that order.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p79" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p79.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p79.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">14. Satisfy the first prerequisite: compose and render timelines</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p80" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p80.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p80.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Thinking.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p80.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
This is the expensive, irreversible turn, so I want the runtime to refuse it
rather than produce a subtly broken render. I require both that every shot have
its retrieved visual and synthesized audio present, and that every spotlight
shot carry a decoration — the second condition is what makes the re-decoration
work of step 9 actually reach the frames instead of sitting unused in state. I
compose all 30 in one batch so that timing offsets are computed against a
single consistent timeline rather than accumulated shot by shot.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p81" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p81.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p81.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Observation.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p81.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
Assets, audio, and decorations exist in state, but no rendered paths do.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p82" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p82.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p82.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Call.</span></span>

<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p83" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p83.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p83.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Return.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p83.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p83.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">status=success</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p83.1.4" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> after 378.6 seconds: </span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p83.1.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">composed=30</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p83.1.6" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">,
</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p83.1.7" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">render_success_count=30</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p83.1.8" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">, </span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p83.1.9" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">failed_count=0</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p83.1.10" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">,
</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p83.1.11" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">concat_count=16</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p83.1.12" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">. The renderer routes by decoration need — the 16
spotlight shots go through the </span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p83.1.13" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">HyperFrames</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p83.1.14" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> backend for template compositing,
the remaining 14 through the direct </span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p83.1.15" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">ffmpeg</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p83.1.16" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> path.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p84" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p84.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p84.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Next decision.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p84.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
One prerequisite remains: background music.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p85" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p85.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p85.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">15. Satisfy the second prerequisite: retrieve background music</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p86" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p86.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p86.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Thinking.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p86.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
The music style I requested back in step 1 is still in state, which is why this
turn is a lookup rather than a re-derivation. I query with the full style
description instead of a keyword, since the retrieval index is caption-based
and the tonal arc — slow building to fast — is what distinguishes a usable
track from a merely orchestral one. I request more duration than the video
needs so the mixer has slack for crossfades and never runs out of music before
the last shot ends. Setting </span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p86.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">must_finish_before_stitch</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p86.1.4" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> makes the
ordering constraint explicit rather than implicit in my turn sequence.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p87" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p87.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p87.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Observation.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p87.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
Thirty rendered shots exist, but the </span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p87.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">bgm</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p87.1.4" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> slot is still empty.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p88" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p88.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p88.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Call.</span></span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p88.2" class="ltx_listing ltx_lstlisting ltx_framed ltx_framed_rectangle ltx_listing" style="--ltx-bg-color:#F1F4F8;--ltx-border-color:#CDD5DF;"><span class="ltx_listing_data"><a href="data:text/plain;base64," download="">⬇</a></span>

</span>

<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p95" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p95.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p95.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Return.</span><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p95.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">

395.0-second delivery:</span></span>

<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p97" class="ltx_para">
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p97.1" class="ltx_p ltx_align_left ltx_align_center"><span class="ltx_ref ltx_nolink ltx_path ltx_font_typewriter ltx_ref_self" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">final_video_with_bgm_20260824_155554.mp4</span></span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p97.2" class="ltx_p ltx_align_left"><span id="A4.p3.pic1.p97.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Takeaway.<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p97.2.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_medium">
This trajectory exhibits the target inference pattern end to end. The policy
constructs a long-horizon production plan before acting, executes real tools,
and treats every runtime failure as a structured observation rather than a
terminal condition. The invented issue identifiers of step 6 are corrected by
running reflection first. The blanket quality failure of step 5 is resolved into
13 addressable defects by step 7. The non-converging repair loop of
steps 10–12 is diagnosed only when the delivery gate at step 13 names
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p97.2.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">rendered_path_ready:0/30</span> as the true blocker. The policy then
satisfies both missing prerequisites and terminates only after the delivered
artifact exists on disk. Notably, the run consumes its full repair budget
without ever entering an unbounded loop, and the final recovery suffix is a
three-call sequence that repeats no earlier work:</span></span></span>
<span id="A4.p3.pic1.p97.3" class="ltx_listing ltx_align_left ltx_lstlisting ltx_framed ltx_framed_rectangle ltx_listing" style="--ltx-bg-color:#F1F4F8;--ltx-border-color:#CDD5DF;"><span class="ltx_listing_data"><a href="data:text/plain;base64,VG9vbF9CYXRjaFRpbWVsaW5lQ29tcG9zZQogICAgLT4gVG9vbF9NdXNpY1NlYXJjaAogICAgLT4gVG9vbF9TdGl0Y2hWaWRlbyAgIChpZGVudGljYWwgYXJndW1lbnRzIHRvIHRoZSByZWplY3RlZCBzdGVwIDEzKQ==" download="">⬇</a></span>
<span id="lstnumberx138" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx138.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Tool_BatchTimelineCompose</span>
</span>
<span id="lstnumberx139" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx139.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">    </span><span id="lstnumberx139.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">-&gt;</span><span id="lstnumberx139.3" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> </span><span id="lstnumberx139.4" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Tool_MusicSearch</span>
</span>
<span id="lstnumberx140" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx140.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">    </span><span id="lstnumberx140.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">-&gt;</span><span id="lstnumberx140.3" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Tool_StitchVideo</span><span id="lstnumberx140.5" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">   </span><span id="lstnumberx140.6" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">(</span><span id="lstnumberx140.7" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">identical</span><span id="lstnumberx140.8" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> </span><span id="lstnumberx140.9" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" id="lstnumberx140.15" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">rejected</span><span id="lstnumberx140.16" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space id="lstnumberx140.19" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">13)</span>
</span>
</span>
</span></span></span></span></foreignObject></g></g></svg></span>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A5" class="ltx_appendix">
<h2 class="ltx_title ltx_title_appendix"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_appendix">Appendix E </span>Visual Inputs to the Evaluation Harness</h2>

<div id="A5.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A5.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Figures <a href="#A5.F7" title="Figure 7 ‣ Appendix E Visual Inputs to the Evaluation Harness ‣ WeVisCut: The Whole Editing Room in One AgentFrom Narration to Long-Form Video" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">7</span></a> and
<a href="#A5.F8" title="Figure 8 ‣ Appendix E Visual Inputs to the Evaluation Harness ‣ WeVisCut: The Whole Editing Room in One AgentFrom Narration to Long-Form Video" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">8</span></a> show two representative
contact-sheet inputs provided to the evaluation harness. Each contact sheet
contains temporally sampled video frames annotated with source-frame indices
and timestamps, allowing the judges to inspect local visual consistency,
timeline progression, long-range coherence, and rendering quality. These
inputs are exposed through read-only, network-free tools and archived together
with their metadata, ensuring that metric decisions are grounded in traceable
visual evidence rather than evaluator-side assumptions.</p>
</div>
<figure id="A5.F7" class="ltx_figure"><img src="2610.38352v1/vis_eval.png" id="A5.F7.g1" class="ltx_graphics ltx_centering ltx_img_portrait" style="aspect-ratio:476/643;" width="476" height="643" alt="Refer to caption">
<figcaption class="ltx_caption ltx_centering"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_figure">Figure 7: </span><span id="A5.F7.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Visual Input to the Evaluation Harness: Case 1.</span>
A contact sheet of temporally sampled and timestamped video frames used
for evidence-grounded diagnostic evaluation.</figcaption>
</figure>
<figure id="A5.F8" class="ltx_figure"><img src="2610.38352v1/vis_eval2.png" id="A5.F8.g1" class="ltx_graphics ltx_centering ltx_img_portrait" style="aspect-ratio:476/643;" width="476" height="643" alt="Refer to caption">
<figcaption class="ltx_caption ltx_centering"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_figure">Figure 8: </span><span id="A5.F8.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Visual Input to the Evaluation Harness: Case 2.</span></figcaption>
</figure>
</section>
<section id="A6" class="ltx_appendix">
<h2 class="ltx_title ltx_title_appendix"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_appendix">Appendix F </span>Limitations</h2>

<div id="A6.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A6.p1.1" class="ltx_p">WeVisCut is limited by the current <span id="A6.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_smallcaps">HyperFrames</span> template library, so uncommon
visual languages may be approximated using the closest available structure,
motion, and style. Expanding the library through automatic template generation could
broaden the design space. The dataset and project-disjoint split cannot cover
all domains, editing conventions, runtimes, or asset distributions, while
verified replay guarantees executability only within the registered runtime.
The quality of long-form videos also depends on the stability of the video
retriever, particularly for instruction-based retrieval. Integrating a trained
video generation model could reduce this dependency and improve robustness.
Finally, VNSM relies on a VLM. Although evidence isolation, frozen anchors,
agreement reporting, and human calibration improve auditability, they cannot
eliminate judge bias or service drift, motivating broader blinded studies and
cross-family audits.</p>
</div>
</section><div class="ltx_rdf" about="" property="dcterms:creator" content="Chenyu Mu, Wenming Weng, Qinrui Wang, Xingsong Ye, Hao Yu, Jun He, Chong Sun, Chen Li, Jing LYU, Erkun Yang, Cheng Deng"></div>
<div class="ltx_rdf" about="" property="dcterms:title" content="WeVisCut: The Whole Editing Room in One Agent -- From Narration to Long-Form Video"></div>
